id.description: The unique identifier of the webhook event delivery.

url.description: The URL the event was delivered to.

trigger.description: The event type that triggered the webhook delivery.

request_headers.description: HTTP headers sent with the webhook request.

request_data.description: The JSON payload body sent in the webhook request.

response_headers.description: HTTP headers returned in the webhook response.

response_body.description: The body of the response from the webhook receiver.

response_status.description: The HTTP response status code returned by the receiver.

execution_duration.description: Time in milliseconds the webhook delivery took.

created_at.description: The date and time the event was delivered.
